The North Star Approach

Music as a creative practice.

At North Star Jazz, music is more than a skill to improve. It is a creative practice, a form of self-expression, and a way to stay connected to yourself and others.

Across our ensembles, classes, lessons, jams, clinics, and workshops, we help musicians develop the tools to grow with confidence and make space for creative development as a lifelong practice.

North Star is offering more than just high-quality tutelage and ensemble coaching. They're pulling together a community of jazz enthusiasts and giving them avenues to share their passion for the art form with each other.
Current North Star Member

Ways to get involved

Not sure where to start? That's what the conversation is for.

Small-Group Ensembles

Regular small-group jazz ensembles, meeting twice a month with a Twin Cities jazz musician as coach. Grouped intentionally by level, instrumentation, and goals.

Group Classes

Group classes for instrumentalists and vocalists at every level. Built around specific skills, with rolling enrollment throughout the year. Currently running:

  • · Foundations of Jazz
  • · Jazz Guitar Foundations
  • · Improv Lab
  • · Jazz Voice Lab
  • · The Jazz Singer's Playground

Private Lessons

One-on-one work with some of the best jazz musicians in the Twin Cities. Useful alongside ensemble work or on their own — at your own pace.

Jam Sessions

Second Sunday Jams at Dual Citizen Brewing, plus other open sessions around town. Supportive, all levels welcome. A great way to meet other players.
